# Test Case Rule: RULE 41: When the MDT bit in mstatus is set to 1 by an explicit CSR write, the MIE bit in mstatus is cleared to 0.

csrw mstatus, t0
li t1, (1<<13)
csrw mstatus, t1
# Result: mstatus[3] = 0

csrw mstatus, t0
